The live-post link the reproduction cites for the 'initial' state (nhl_goal_bot status 1909755726387437819) is about a DIFFERENT goal of the same game (Callahan, 19:24 of P1), so that citation does not document the pre-change assist.

notes: The goal, the scorer and the number of goals are all unchanged: this is an assist re-attribution, so the game total (BOS 7 - NJD 2) is untouched and only player-prop markets can be affected. The corrected state is verified against the official report alone in this pass; the report is internally consistent with the reproduced statement on two independent season totals (Geekie 23, Wotherspoon 6). The pre-change assist rests on the reproduction, and the reproduction's own citation for it does not support it, which is recorded as an unresolved irregularity rather than resolved by inference.
